format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: Готовим блок

probes.title: load now fetches at once and puts the answer in place of the skeleton; the region is no longer busy

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#now'); const root = el.querySelector(':scope > .sf-include'); return el.querySelector('#fixture-now')?.textContent === 'Загружено' && root.getAttribute('aria-busy') === 'false' && !el.hasAttribute('data-loading') && !el.querySelector('sf-skeleton'); })()

probes.title: load view below the fold fetches nothing and shows the skeleton until it is scrolled near; then it loads once

steps.check: (() => { const fetched = (name) => performance.getEntriesByType('resource').some((entry) => entry.name.includes(name)); return !fetched('/fixture/view') && !document.querySelector('#fixture-view') && Boolean(document.querySelector('#view sf-skeleton')); })()

(() => { const fetched = (name) => performance.getEntriesByType('resource').some((entry) => entry.name.includes(name)); return Boolean(document.querySelector('#view #fixture-view')) && !document.querySelector('#view sf-skeleton') && !fetched('/fixture/own'); })()

probes.title: the page's slot placeholder stands in for the skeleton while the part waits
a 404 is the error state: the message in a polite status and Retry; refresh answers refused http 404 and sends load-failed
probes.covers: events.load-failed, actions.refresh, host-states data-failed, lang runtime.failed, runtime.retry

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#broken'); const message = el.querySelector('.sf-include-error [role="status"]'); const retry = el.querySelector('.sf-include-retry .sf-button-text-container'); return el.hasAttribute('data-failed') && message?.textContent.trim() === 'Не удалось загрузить эту часть страницы.' && retry?.textContent.trim() === 'Повторить'; })()

probes.title: Retry loads the same address again; when it answers, the part takes the error's place

steps.script:
(() => { const real = window.fetch.bind(window); window.fetch = (input, init) => String(input).includes('/missing/part') ? Promise.resolve(new Response('

Снова на месте

', {status: 200, headers: {'content-type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8'}})) : real(input, init); return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#broken'); return el.querySelector('#fixed')?.textContent === 'Снова на месте' && !el.querySelector('.sf-include-error') && !el.hasAttribute('data-failed'); })()

probes.title: a Smart component in the part is loaded by the Loader and draws; the part's scripts and inline handlers do not run, a JSON island stays
probes.covers: the Loader over inserted markup, partFrom

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#smart'); const badge = el.querySelector('#inner'); return Boolean(customElements.get('sf-badge')) && badge?.isRendered === true && badge.textContent.includes('Новое') && window.__includeRan !== true && !el.querySelector('script:not([type])') && Boolean(el.querySelector('script[data-keep]')) && !el.querySelector('#trap').hasAttribute('onerror'); })()

probes.title: a new src loads the new part in place of the old one
on an English page the error speaks English

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#en'); return el.querySelector('.sf-include-message')?.textContent.trim() === 'Could not load this part of the page.' && el.querySelector('.sf-include-retry .sf-button-text-container')?.textContent.trim() === 'Retry'; })()
